en.headline: Hong Kong men’s foil team takes Asian Games silver after final loss to Japan
en.dek: Ryan Choi, Cheung Ka-long, Harris Ho and Leung Chin-yu fell 36-45 to the host nation in Nagoya, securing silver and a HK$1 million incentive award.
body: Hong Kong’s men’s foil team claimed silver at the Asian Games on Friday after a 36-45 defeat to host Japan in the final at the Aichi Sky Expo in Nagoya.

Harris Ho opened against Japan’s Kyosuke Matsuyama and the side trailed 1-5. Olympic champion Cheung Ka-long then scored three points against individual gold medallist Kazuki Iimura, but Ryan Choi lost his bout 1-5, allowing Japan to open a ten-point lead.

Hong Kong mounted a fightback. Ho and Cheung each outscored their opponents 9-5 in later relays to close the gap. Entering the final relay trailing 34-40, Ho faced Iimura but conceded three consecutive touches, ending the match 36-45.
The team had earlier beaten India, Uzbekistan and South Korea 45-41 in the semi-finals. Under the Jockey Club Athlete Incentive Awards Scheme the squad will receive HK$1 million for the silver medal.

zh.headline: 港隊男花團體亞運決賽負日本奪銀
zh.dek: 蔡俊彥、張家朗、何承謙及梁千雨周五在名古屋以36：45不敵東道主日本，奪得銀牌，可獲賽馬會獎勵計劃100萬元獎金。
body: 香港男子花劍隊周五在名古屋亞運決賽以36：45不敵東道主日本，奪得銀牌。
何承謙首場對松山京介以1：5落後，奧運冠軍張家朗其後對個人金牌得主飯村一輝取得三分，但蔡俊彥一場以1：5落敗，日本拉開至十分優勢。
港隊其後反擊，何承謙及張家朗在第五及第七場均以9：5勝出，縮窄差距。最後一場何承謙以34：40落後出戰飯村一輝，連失三分，最終36：45落敗。
港隊早前已擊敗印度、烏茲別克及南韓晉級。根據賽馬會運動員獎勵計劃，銀牌可獲100萬元獎金。
